method: NAIVE. Written straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate. One pass, no review.
edition_encoded: Immigration Act 1959 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/IA1959.txt (amendments to Act 31 of 2023, Act 5 of 2025 and Act 16 of 2026).

checks.command: l4 run imm-cases-entry-status.l4 ; l4 run imm-cases-offences.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: SCOPED. imm-entry-status.l4: s 5 (authorised crossing points), ss 6 and 7 (who may enter), s 8 (prohibited immigrants), s 9 (entry bans), s 9AA (no-boarding directives), ss 11 and 14A (PRs abroad and automatic cancellation), s 11A (loss of citizenship), s 12 (endorsement), ss 14 and 15 (cancellation and overstaying), s 36 (return after removal), ss 39A and 39B (ouster of judicial review, no hearing). imm-offences.l4: s 57(1)(d) with (7) to (7D) (harbouring), s 57(1)(e) with (1A) and (8) to (10) (employment), s 57A (construction sites), s 57C (marriages of convenience), s 57(1)(k) and (ka) (false information), ss 58 and 59. Not encoded: s 2, Part 2A (visas), Part 4 (arrival procedure and passenger information), Part 5 (removal and detention), Parts 5A and 5B, and most of Part 6. No regulations retrieved; the PR re-entry prescribed period is in them.
